INSERT INTO yglue_project_snapshot_class (snapshot_id, qualified_name, simple_name, package_name, kind, source_type, jar_id, doc) VALUES (#{snapshotId}, #{qualifiedName}, #{simpleName}, #{packageName}, #{kind}, #{sourceType}, #{jarId}, #{doc})
INSERT INTO yglue_project_snapshot_class_field (class_id, name, type, is_static) VALUES (#{classId}, #{name}, #{type}, #{static})
INSERT INTO yglue_project_snapshot_class_method (class_id, name, return_type, is_static, parameters_json) VALUES (#{classId}, #{name}, #{returnType}, #{static}, #{parametersJson})
